description: This PHP class 'Education' extends 'ListableDisplayField' and is part of the OrangeHRM system's reporting module. It defines display fields related to the education information in reports, specifying the associated DTO class, entity aliases, and fields to be used in reports.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: Represents an education display field in the reporting module, providing DTO class, entity aliases, and fields for report generation.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO associated with this display field, which is 'Dto\Education'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases, here just ['education'], used for query construction.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array containing the field 'employee.empNumber', indicating the employee number field included in reports.
